name: OpenAI API token pricing (serverless, per 1M tokens, 2026-10-04 list price)
region: global API (no regional GPU to price; inference is OpenAI-operated)
price_basis: USD per 1M TOKENS, LIST PRICE, observed 2026-10-04. Standard tier, gpt-6.1-sol: input $2.00, cached input $0.10, cache write $2.50, output $10.00 (short context). Long-context (>=200k prompt) doubles every column: input $4.00, cached $0.20, write $5.00, output $15.00. Standard tier flagship gpt-6-astra: short input $10.00 / cached $1.00 / write $12.50 / output $50.00; long context $20.00 / $2.00 / $25.00 / $75.00. Cheapest standard model gpt-6-luna: short input $0.10 / cached $0.01 / write $0.125 / output $0.50; long context $0.20 / $0.02 / $0.25 / $0.75. Same-page tier multipliers observed on gpt-6.1-sol short-context input: Batch $1.00, Flex $1.00 (i.e. 50% off Standard), Fast $4.00 (2x), Ultrafast $8.00 (4x). price_usd carries the input rate of gpt-6.1-sol as the single representative number.
notes: THESE ARE LIST PRICES AND THEY ARE THE FASTEST-STALING NUMBERS IN THE REPO. Two structural things a reader must not miss. (1) OpenAI prices by TIER as well as by model, and the tiers are the same underlying model: Batch and Flex are both exactly 50% of Standard, Fast is 2x, Ultrafast is 4x on the same gpt-6.1-sol row. Quoting an OpenAI price without naming the tier is meaningless - the same tokens differ 8x between Flex and Ultrafast. (2) Every model has TWO price rows, short context and long context, and the split is not a gentle surcharge - it is exactly 2x on the current lineup. xAI and Anthropic do the same thing (see rent-anthropic-api-token-pricing and rent-xai-api-token-pricing). Never mix a long-context input rate with a short-context output rate; that is an easy 4x error. Non-token charges on the same page that belong in a total-cost model: file search storage $0.10/GB/day (1 GB free), web search $10.00/1k calls plus search-content tokens billed at model rates, tool calls $2.50/1k calls, hosted-shell/code-interpreter containers $0.03/$0.12/$0.48/$1.92 per 20-minute session for 1/4/16/64 GB, Realtime audio billed per 1M tokens on a separate column set from text. OpenAI publishes NO GPU hourly rate and NO region list - the serving fleet is not a purchasable product, which is why this record has an empty accelerator_ids list rather than a guess.
